summary.name: AI TikTok Analyzer Pro
summary.one_liner: A Chrome extension and web workbench for researching public TikTok creators, downloading videos, generating AI transcripts, and drafting scripts and hashtags.
use_cases: Researching a TikTok creator's top videos by plays, likes or comments
Downloading public TikTok videos without a watermark
Exporting TikTok comment threads for analysis
Generating transcripts and translated captions for videos
Planning campaigns and drafting scripts from competitor content
summary.what_it_does: The tool runs as a Chrome extension and a web workbench for public TikTok creator research. It can download single or batch videos in original quality without a watermark, and queue a whole profile or only videos that pass a filter. It offers speech-to-text transcripts with bilingual captions, comment translation and export to raw data, and AI comment insights. It also computes creator analytics from the videos on a profile, supports custom sorting and filters, and shows hashtag and shop/product research.
notable: Watermark-free downloads with single and batch queueing
AI transcripts and bilingual captions in nine interface languages
Comment export and AI comment insights
Creator analytics computed from public profile videos
caveats: Limited to public creator data; the page says it is for authorized media only
Platforms named are Chrome extension and web; no other platforms mentioned
Pricing details are not on the page; freemium comes from the directory listing only
